column2: deleting the entire `## extracted script registry` section (roughly `skills/implement/skill.md:93-149`) also removes nested `### bash block prelude` and `### verbosity control` subsections. those are orchestrator contracts (one-line post-step-0 fence rules, `larch-run.sh` launcher delegation, bans on inline `plugin-root.env` / full `session-env.sh` sourcing, pre-bootstrap guard carve-outs, verbosity allow/deny lists), not reachability inventory. a literal full-section delete drops them before `## rebase checkpoint macro` and breaks `/implement` fence discipline; `scripts/test-implement-structure.md` treats those launcher invariants as load-bearing.

the plan deletes the full extracted script registry (including the old-shape `pr closes-issue` structured-invocation bash fence at `skills/implement/skill.md:109-117`) while also saying bash fence counts should stay unchanged and `test-implement-fence-shape` should usually stay unchanged. that fence is one of three old-shape fences pinned at `scripts/test-implement-fence-shape.sh:36-37` (`expected_old=3`; contract in `scripts/test-implement-fence-shape.md`). removing the registry section drops the old-shape count to 2 and ci fails unless `expected_old` and sibling doc invariants are updated. preserving the fence in always-loaded `skill.md` would undermine the reachability prose removal goal.

the agent-lint exclude list omits extracted script registry-only wrapper scripts anchored only in the deleted registry (`post-tracking-issue.sh`, `generate-code-flow-diagram.sh`, `refresh-execution-issues.sh`, `write-final-report.sh`, `cleanup.sh`, `step-0-degraded-gate.sh`). the lazy reference must not re-anchor them, so `make lint` will flag orphaned scripts after deletion.

the plan's exclude coverage for the deleted design wrapper inventory at `skills/design/skill.md:80-136` is incomplete. deleting the wrapper inventory would still leave command anchors like `python/cli.py plan validator-autofix`, `python/cli.py design step2b-drafter`, `python/cli.py design step2b-postplan`, `python/cli.py design step2b5`, and the step 6 and step-final-summary command forms unexcluded; `plan.txt:28-81` only enumerates an earlier subset.

the implement-side agent-lint exclude plan does not fully cover paths anchored only in deleted machine-reachability blocks. after deleting `skills/implement/skill.md:310-334` and related sections, paths including `python/test_execution_issues.py` (inventory line at `:322` is the only anchor), `python/cli.py stall-recovery`, `python/stall_recovery.py`, `python/test_stall_recovery.py`, `python/test_oos_filer.py`, and `python/larch/design/clarify.py` have no remaining `skill.md` anchor and are not reliably covered by the vague "cover removed cli" clause. separately, `scripts/test-implement-fence-shape.sh` is anchored only in the deleted registry "structural harness reachability" line (`skills/implement/skill.md:107`) and is absent from the plan exclude list (unlike `python/test_preflight.py`, already excluded at `agent-lint.toml:820-821`), so agent-lint s030 can flag it after deletion.
